fields.caption: you can't get caught using AI bots to attack AI critics / if you publish the articles in 44 seconds and call it journalism

narrative_summary: The joke uses Roll Safe's smug tautological logic to mock OpenAI's super PAC for thinking speed-running AI-generated hit pieces through a 44-second editorial process was a viable disguise for a $125M astroturf operation.
rationale: Candidate 4 earns the highest score by layering three specific details — the AI bot hit pieces, the 44-second editorial turnaround, and the $125M super PAC scale — into a closing beat that adds 'and call it journalism,' which reframes the absurdity as smug self-delusion rather than just restating the setup. The escalation voice pays off: the punchline does actual work instead of echoing the premise.
story_title: OpenAI's super PAC is funding AI-generated news site attacking industry critics
